data.name: Kainat
data.gender_notes: Kainat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kainat is an Arabic name that refers to the universe or creation. It symbolizes the vastness and beauty of Allah's creation. The name Kainat carries the meaning “Universe, Creation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kainat usually hope their child will grow to embody universe, creation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Kainat is seen as a reminder of Allah's power and majesty in creating the universe.
data.etymology: Kainat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Universe, Creation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kainat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
